title: Large language model empowered participatory urban planning

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating an 'Inclusion' metric that calculates whether the generated urban plans adequately meet the specific facility accessibility needs (e.g., distance to clinics or parks) of elderly individuals living alone.
Using an 'Inclusion' metric to measure how equitably the participatory planning framework addresses the spatial and facility requirements of rental migrants.
Assessing the accessibility of requested facilities for families with patients through a dedicated 'Inclusion' metric to prevent marginalization in urban planning outcomes.
